reviews.review:
Space Marine hasn't aged extraordinarily well, but it is still a solid game and one of the best third person shooter games set in the 40k universe out there. Fighting is fun and the melee combat feels very visceral most of the time, plus it solves the vulnerability of melee combat through a heal by kill mechanic.

Pros:
- 40k space marine hack and slash and shoot that lets you mow down hordes of enemies.
- (for 40k lore buffs) Actually follows the lore pretty well with the danger and deadliness of the enemies compared to your force commander.
- The story is fun, if straightforward.
- Lots of fun toys to destroy xenos and heretics with.
- Its pretty well polished for a warhammer game.

Cons:
- There is a surprising lack of enemy diversity
- Bosses and mini bosses can feel like a slog due to how much damage they soak up
- Along with bosses and mini bosses some late game enemies are just bullet sponges
- Late game melee is hard to justify due to the danger.
- Controls can be kind of wonky at times.

TLDR; Who knew playing an ultrasmurf could be so fun?
This game happens when Just Cause merges with literally any third-person shooter that looks decent, and it just works.

hack and slash game but if you're a fan of warhammer you will love this ! the story was more then i imagined from this type of game but im left wanting more of captain titus !! , gameplay is fun and challenging all in one
Seamlessly cutting through hordes of orks = Satisfying.

Awesome scenery,  various weapons and strategies. 

-You absolutely need to start you combo's before you enemy reaches you.-

It starts out pretty bland, just a few types of Ork, pretty straightforward combat. It very quickly becomes a lot more ... interesting. There's no Arkham/Assassins creed timed combat. You need to crowd control intelligently, kite around mobs and use your firepower properly.

Early on, you're just chopping your ways through hordes. Soon enough, you'll need to be smart about picking your first enemy, keeping an appropriate distance and timing your blows. There are no warnings or prompts, only enemies whose attacks are not interrupted unless you end an appropriate combo before they can hit you.

11 hours of great fun on medium.
